_about: Example TV Time Capsule configuration. Copy to ~/.config/tv-time-capsule/config.json and edit paths, mounts, and keys. Keys starting with _ are documentation only and are ignored by the app.

mounts._example: Samba / CIFS — password in OS keychain (see docs/usage/secrets.md)
Samba / CIFS — credentials file instead of keychain

_channels.order: Show folder names in desired browse / priority order (unknown names skipped)
_channels.numbers: Optional fixed channel numbers; unlisted shows use 1-based position in the ordered lineup

_library.rescan_interval_seconds: Periodic rescan while idle on the show list (0 = off)
_library.rescan_long_press_ms: Hold R (reset key) this long to rescan without restarting

_kids_mode.default_enabled: Fallback when enabled is omitted — first launch only
_kids_mode.enabled: Persisted parent/kids mode (written when you toggle Tab); restored on next start
_kids_mode.allowlist: Omit for full kids library (legacy). Once present, kids mode only shows tagged shows/movies; parent K toggles tags

_network.mdns_hostname: LAN browse name without .local — set by install.sh / install-pi.sh (--hostname)
_network.admin_port: Web admin TCP port; Avahi HTTP service uses this during install

_admin.bind: 0.0.0.0 for LAN phones; 127.0.0.1 for SSH tunnel only

_playback.autoplay: off | next_episode | next_in_season_only — advance after an episode ends naturally
_playback.autoplay_countdown_seconds: Seconds before the next episode starts (0 = instant). Esc cancels during countdown.
_playback.now_playing_splash: Show episode summary before playback starts (default true)
_playback.now_playing_splash_seconds: How long the summary stays on screen (default 1.5; 0 = skip even if enabled)
_playback.hw_decode: auto | on | off — Pi V4L2 hardware H.264 decode (auto = H.264 only on Raspberry Pi)

_cache.enabled: Background-copy remote episodes to local disk for smoother playback (default true)
_cache.max_bytes: LRU cache size cap in bytes (default 2 GiB)
_cache.prefetch_next: Start caching the next autoplay episode during the countdown (default true)
_cache.cache_before_playing: Wait on the now-playing title screen with a progress bar until the episode is fully cached (default false; avoids mid-playback cache switch)

_ui.channel_snow: FUN TWEAK — B&W static burst when committing channel numbers on show/season/episode lists (not arrow keys). Pre-cached 320ms animation. CLI: --channel-snow
_ui.shutdown_collapse: FUN TWEAK — CRT vertical collapse on quit. CLI: --shutdown-collapse
_ui.channel_snow_audio: FUN TWEAK — Quiet white-noise with channel snow (defaults on when channel_snow is true; set false to mute)
_ui.analog_artifacts: FUN TWEAK — Random brief static, line tear, and vertical roll on the show browser only. CLI: --analog-artifacts
_ui.analog_artifact_rate: Glitches per minute when analog_artifacts is on (default 12; 0 = no timed glitches)
_ui.footer_hints: Bottom status bar (clock + help key) on browse screens in parent mode (toggle with F5 by default; always off in kids mode)

_safe_zone.top: Overscan padding above the 640×480 UI (% of UI height). Extends the framebuffer outward — UI is never scaled.
_safe_zone.bottom: Padding below the UI (% of UI height — often higher on CRTs, e.g. 8)
_safe_zone.left: Padding left of the UI (% of UI width)
_safe_zone.right: Padding right of the UI (% of UI width)
_safe_zone.offset_x: Optional pixel shift right within the safe area (asymmetric overscan tuning)
_safe_zone.offset_y: Optional pixel shift down within the safe area
_safe_zone.offset: Optional shorthand { "x": N, "y": N } or [x, y] for offset_x/y
_safe_zone.margin: Optional shorthand — uniform %% on all sides (e.g. 5 or {"margin": 5})
_safe_zone.vertical: Optional shorthand for top and bottom together
_safe_zone.horizontal: Optional shorthand for left and right together

_easter_eggs.test_patterns: Any parent browse screen — press 001, 002, or 003 for full-screen colorbars.png, grid.png, indianhead.png from src/tv_time_capsule/assets/ (you supply the PNGs; app never generates them). Esc exits. Bare 0 = Back; 00 = alphabet menu. See docs/usage/fun-tweaks-and-easter-eggs.md

_gamepad: USB controllers via SDL. Remap live in-app with F4 (gamepad configuration). Bindings use readable tokens: button-N, hat-up/down/left/right, stick-up/down/left/right.

_keymap_reference.up: Browse up / volume up during playback (default: Up arrow)
_keymap_reference.down: Browse down / volume down during playback (default: Down arrow)
_keymap_reference.left: Back / seek backward 10s during playback (default: Left arrow)
_keymap_reference.right: Select / seek forward 10s during playback (default: Right arrow)
_keymap_reference.select: Select / play / pause-resume (default: Enter, keypad Enter, Space)
_keymap_reference.quit: Quit app — parent mode only (default: Q)
_keymap_reference.help: Context help for the current screen (default: H)
_keymap_reference.reset: Reset watch status — tap; hold to rescan library (default: R)
_keymap_reference.keymap_reset: Reset all key bindings to defaults on key-setup screen (default: F3)
_keymap_reference.keymap_remove: Remove last binding for highlighted action on key-setup screen (default: Delete)
_keymap_reference.letter_menu: Open alphabet jump menu on show/movie list — parent mode (default: L)
_keymap_reference.kids_tag_toggle: Tag/untag title for kids allowlist — parent mode (default: K)
_keymap_reference.footer_hints_toggle: Toggle browse status bar — parent mode (default: F5)

_keymap_notes: Each action accepts a key name string or an array of names (aliases). Examples: escape, enter, space, q, f2, up, num-0.
Legacy integer pygame key codes still load correctly.
Omit an action or use an empty keymap object {} to keep defaults.
Rebind in-app with F2. F3 on that screen resets to defaults; Delete removes the last alias.
Left/right on the key-setup screen change pages. Assigning a key already used elsewhere moves it to the new action.
_screensaver: FUN TWEAK — Bouncing VHS logo (vhs.bmp, 2x pixelated) on a black screen after menu idle time. Random multiply tint on each bounce. Any key dismisses.

_mount_fields.type: Required. cifs | smb | nfs | sshfs | sftp | ftp | ftps
_mount_fields.source: Required. Share URL or remote path
_mount_fields.options: Optional. Array of mount options or comma-separated string
_mount_fields.password: Optional. Literal password (discouraged — use keyring or credentials file)
_mount_fields.keyring: Optional. OS keychain item name for the password
_mount_fields.username_keyring: Optional. OS keychain item name for the username
_mount_fields.identity_file: Optional. SSH private key for sshfs

_setup: Development: cp config.example.json config.json  (repo root; auto-discovered)
Remove unused entries from media_paths and delete mount blocks you do not need.
Mountpoints are scanned automatically even if omitted from media_paths.
